implementation: Connected real game-authored FVF and SM3 Draw/DrawIndexed D3DRS_CLIPPING=FALSE to explicitly opted-in incomplete RAW D3D11 diagnostic tiles. Original source state getter, valid DWORD, native GPU resource and backbuffer admission remain required. The game-authoritative D3D9 Draw/Present/input/FFB and ordinary exact native mode are unchanged. A native RAW clipping mismatch always aborts full-resolution frame publication after GPU draw; SM3 also omits inherited user-clip planes only for its opt-in incomplete RAW tile. Regression exercises valid and invalid clipping source state plus both native submission/abort paths. No actual game/HMD testing.

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: Source-authenticated CLIPPING=FALSE FVF and shader-bound SM3 can issue native D3D11 Draw/DrawIndexed in explicitly opted-in RAW visual preview with real game geometry and independently captured GPU tile.
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Unknown/failed CLIPPING state, ordinary full-frame mode, invalid/foreign source targets, unsafe COM/resource states and all incomplete RAW frame promotion fail closed; exact true clipping and original D3D9 input unaffected.
acceptance_proof.component_integration: live_game_frame_bridge.cpp FVF supported_game_state and submit_live_sm3_game_draw -> native_game_raw_clipping_visual.hpp -> D3D11 GPU Draw -> full_frame abort; portable C++ assertions and tools/test_dx11_live_sm3_table_zfog_01005.py exercise both routes.

development_strategy.visible_frame_acceptance: SOURCE_STAGE_ONLY_GATE_PENDING. LIVE runtime game pixel and HMD output UNTESTED, no full-frame gameplay PASS.
development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: Requires OUTRUN_DX11_FIRST_GAME_FRAME=1, OUTRUN_DX11_FULL_GAME_FRAME=1, OUTRUN_DX11_RAW_VISUAL_DIAGNOSTIC=1; normal path exact and fail-closed, incomplete GPU tile only, original D3D9 Draw/gamepad/FFB/DX9Ex fallback preserved.

feature_contract.goal: Connect authentic game FVF and programmable SM3 clipping-disabled Draws to a native D3D11 GPU visual diagnostic while retaining original D3D9 fallback and forbidding incomplete full-frame publication.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Actual source CLIPPING=FALSE and opt-in diagnostic can reach both native FVF and SM3 GPU Draw while SM3 suppresses inherited user clip planes.
Unknown source DWORD, no RAW opt-in, unsafe resources and partial native frame remain D3D9-authoritative; original gamepad/FFB not changed.
DX11 Fast, Backend, Build, OpenXR and HUD gates run and pass at one final matching source-bearing SHA.

runtime_note: RUNTIME_VALIDATION=UNTESTED; no actual source-matched game launch, live native Draw count, published frame count, GPU desktop pixel or Quest3/VDXR evidence.
real_game_draw_blocker: Actual CLIPPING=FALSE source Draw population, GPU tile pixel and full game frame remain UNTESTED; this isolated RAW source admission is not native complete-frame proof.
next_implementation_action: On matching source SHA, collect game-authored D3D9 Draw/native GPU RGB evidence with genuine clipping state before deciding next full-frame blocker; preserve DX9Ex fallback and OpenXR isolation.
score_note: One unfinished DX11 native complete-frame feature. CI repair, same TASK_ID checkpoint, RAW source expansion and retest do not earn duplicate independent achievement points (+0).
